title: Usage Insights: add route+model cost aggregation job + hourly schema (late events + partitions)
author: Mei Lin
release_notes: Internal only: introduces new aggregated dataset for in-console Usage Insights (route+model), behind feature flag consumers. No user-visible change until query API/console lands.
body:
## Summary
Implements the first-pass aggregation job + warehouse schema for “In-console usage insights” breakdowns keyed by workspace/project/env + route_template + model_family/model_version + region/deployment_mode, bucketed hourly.

This PR creates:
- A new hourly aggregate table for route+model usage/cost drivers (tokens in/out, cache hits/misses, retries, fallbacks, request counts, latency rollups)
- An incremental aggregation job with partitioning & clustering tuned for interactive console queries
- Late-event handling (watermark + rolling recompute window) to reduce drift vs billing
- Initial correctness checks comparing aggregated totals to billing/metering rollups

Primary goal: power ENG-3814 (query endpoints) and keep totals reconcilable with billing within a small tolerance.

## Details
### New dataset/table
Table: `telemetry_analytics.usage_insights_route_model_hourly`

Key dimensions (columns):
- `bucket_start_ts` (UTC, hour)
- `workspace_id`, `project_id`, `environment`
- `route_template` (normalized path template, e.g. `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/files/{file_id}`)
- `route_group` (coarser grouping for guardrails; e.g. `openai_compat`)
- `model_family`, `model_version` (stable bucketing; alias resolution happens upstream)
- `deployment_mode` (`hosted|dedicated|private`)
- `region` (cloud region or `onprem`)

Measures:
- `request_count`
- `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`
- `cache_hit_tokens`, `cache_miss_tokens`
- `retry_request_count` (count of retried attempts, excluding first attempt)
- `fallback_request_count` (requests served by a different model than requested)
- `streaming_request_count` (for later “streaming overhead” attribution)
- `latency_ms_sum`, `latency_ms_p95_approx` (t-digest sketch)
- `compute_cost_microusd` (sum of attribution cost; matches billing hooks source)

Partitioning/clustering:
- Partition: `DATE(bucket_start_ts)`
- Cluster: `workspace_id, project_id, route_template, model_family, model_version`

Rationale: console queries typically filter by workspace/project + time range and then group by route/model. Clustering improves scan costs and p95 for “top routes/models” tables.

### Aggregation job
Job: `UsageInsightsRouteModelHourlyAggregator`

- Runs every 15 minutes
- Processes a rolling window of the last 48 hours to capture late events and backfilled metering corrections
- Uses a watermark based on `event_ingested_at` with a default late allowance of 6 hours
- Writes via MERGE/UPSERT keyed on all dimensions + `bucket_start_ts`

Pseudo-logic (simplified):
`SELECT … FROM metering_events WHERE event_time >= now()-48h GROUP BY bucket_start_ts, dims` then `MERGE INTO usage_insights_route_model_hourly`.

### Late events + correctness
Late-event strategy is intentionally conservative for beta:
- Recompute 48h each run to avoid “stuck wrong totals” in the presence of late arrivals/retries
- Emit lag metrics (`usage_insights_agg_lag_seconds`, `usage_insights_late_event_ratio`) for dashboards

Correctness tests (initial):
- For a fixed fixture workspace/time window, compare `SUM(compute_cost_microusd)` in the new hourly table to the existing billing rollup query
- Tolerance: 0.5% or 50,000 microusd (whichever is higher)
- Log detailed breakdown on mismatch (top 10 contributing route/model rows)

NOTE: There is a known edge case where streaming token accounting can shift across hour boundaries when events are emitted late; the recompute window should cover it, but we may still see small intra-day fluctuations until ENG-3822 (route tags on streaming) is fully rolled out.

## Why
Customers and internal teams need route+model cost breakdowns with consistent totals vs billing. This is the foundational dataset that all subsequent APIs/console pages will query.

## Screenshots
N/A (backend job + dataset only)

## Testing
- Unit tests for bucketing, aggregation math, and merge keying
- Warehouse integration test against a small seeded dataset
- Correctness test comparing to billing rollup query

## Rollout / Ops
- Job is deployed but consumer paths are not enabled yet.
- Metrics emitted:
  - `usage_insights_agg_job_duration_ms`
  - `usage_insights_agg_rows_written`
  - `usage_insights_agg_lag_seconds`
  - `usage_insights_agg_reconcile_diff_ratio`
- Alert wiring will be added in a follow-up PR in the observability pack.

## Follow-ups
- ENG-3813: route normalization library shared with gateway (this PR assumes normalized `route_template` exists on metering events)
- ENG-3814: query API endpoints consuming this dataset
- ENG-3817: expand reconciliation coverage + CI gating

Closes: ENG-3812
Refs: SUP-24811 (billing mismatch reports; correctness guardrails)

## Checklist
- [x] Schema reviewed with Telemetry & Analytics
- [x] Partition/clustering reviewed for expected query patterns
- [x] Late-event handling documented in code comments
- [x] Added initial reconciliation tests
- [x] Added metrics for freshness/lag
commits: telemetry/warehouse: add usage_insights_route_model_hourly table schema + migrations
analytics/jobs: implement hourly aggregator with rolling recompute + merge upsert
tests: add seeded warehouse integration test + billing reconciliation assertion
docs(internal): add runbook notes + query examples in job README
conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Partitioning/clustering looks right. Can we avoid scanning 48h every 15m? That’s going to be expensive at scale.

Mei Lin (author): Agreed it’s not ideal long-term. For beta I’d prefer correctness > cost. Added a TODO + metrics so we can tighten window once late arrival distribution is measured. Also added a guardrail: if recompute window > 72h, job refuses to run.

Nadia Rahman (review): Please clarify retry/fallback definitions in code comments. Specifically: is a retry counted per attempt or per request? And are fallbacks counted when model differs from requested alias or resolved family?

Mei Lin (author): Updated comments + renamed `retry_count` to `retry_request_count` to make intent clear: counts extra attempts (attempt_index > 0). Fallback is when `served_model_family/version` != `requested_model_family/version` after alias resolution.

Cole Summers (review): Reconciliation tolerance seems loose. Can we log the top contributing rows on mismatch? This will come up in SUP-24811-type tickets.

Mei Lin (author): Added mismatch logging (top 10 rows by absolute cost delta) and included the query fingerprint + window in the failure output.

Allison Grant (review): Please emit aggregation lag as a gauge and include tags for dataset + environment. Also add a metric for late event ratio if possible.

Mei Lin (author): Done: `usage_insights_agg_lag_seconds{dataset="route_model_hourly"}` and `usage_insights_late_event_ratio{dataset=...}`.

Thomas Baird (review): The MERGE key includes `route_group` and `route_template`. If route_group is derived from route_template, keep only one in the key to reduce churn.

Mei Lin (author): route_group is derived but we want to preserve it for coarse grouping even if normalization changes. Kept it as a non-key attribute (updated merge statement accordingly) so we don’t create duplicate rows.

Approvals:
- Logan Wright: Approved
